metaTitle: Fortnite Weapon Damage Calculator – Shots to Kill & DPS
metaDescription: Calculate shots-to-kill, DPS, and time-to-kill for every Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 3 weapon. Compare damage vs. shields, headshots, and structures.
hero: Approximate shots-to-kill, DPS, and time-to-kill for Chapter 7 Season 3 weapons. Values are for planning — Epic changes balance mid-season, so confirm in-game after patches.
needsReload: Needs a reload — magazine only holds {mag} shots ({dmg} damage).
howTitle: How weapon damage works in Fortnite
howP1: Players normally have 100 HP + up to 100 shield (200 effective). Some limited-time modes or items can change that — use the custom HP field when needed.
howP2: Headshots multiply body damage (often ~1.5x on many guns; snipers and some precision weapons can be higher). Structure damage uses approximate placed/max wall HP for wood / brick / metal — walls also heal after placement, so live TTK on builds can differ.
